/hr/tccr.io-truecharts-cloudflared.title: cloudflared helm release
/hr/tccr.io-truecharts-cloudflared.name: cloudflared
/hr/tccr.io-truecharts-cloudflared.doc: Cloudflared is a lightweight proxy client for securely connecting applications to Cloudflare’s network. It powers Cloudflare Tunnel, allowing services to be exposed without opening ports or configuring firewall rules. cloudflared routes traffic through Cloudflare’s global network, enhancing security with DDoS protection, authentication, and encrypted connections. It supports HTTP, TCP, and QUIC, making it ideal for self-hosted services, remote access, and zero-trust networking.

0:
config:
  bind: 0.0.0.0:{{ .Values.service.main.ports.main.port }}
  onlineMode: true
  debug: true
  query:
    enabled: true
    port: {{ .Values.service.main.ports.query.port }}
    showPlugins: false
  lite:
    enabled: true
    routes:
      - host: [modpack.${DOMAIN_0}]
        backend: minecraft-modpack-minecraft-java.minecraft.svc.cluster.local:25565
        cachePingTTL: -1s
        fallback:
          motd: |
            §cModpack server is offline.
            §eCheck back later!
          version:
            name: '§cTry again later!'
            protocol: -1
          favicon: /icons/server-icon.png
      - host: [tcpshield.${DOMAIN_0}, ${DOMAIN_0}]
        backend: minecraft-vanilla-minecraft-java.minecraft.svc.cluster.local:25565
        cachePingTTL: -1s
        fallback:
          motd: |
            §cVanilla server is offline.
            §eCheck back later!
          version:
            name: '§cTry again later!'
            protocol: -1
          favicon: /icons/server-icon.png

logging:
  format: json
  level: WARN
  output: "-"
database:
  type: "postgres"
blockstore:
  type: s3
  s3:
    force_path_style: true
    discover_bucket_region: false
